title: Operations Research
description:
Studied mathematical optimization techniques used to support decision-making, allocate limited resources, and improve operational efficiency.

Key Topics Covered:

Linear Programming: Mathematical formulation of optimization problems using objective functions, decision variables, and constraints.

Simplex Method: Solving linear programming problems to identify optimal solutions under resource constraints.

Transportation Problems: Developing cost-minimization models to determine efficient allocation and transportation of resources between supply and demand locations.

Knowledge Gained:

Developed an understanding of how mathematical models and optimization techniques can support resource allocation, cost reduction, and data-driven decision-making in industrial and operational systems.
